title: feat(cli): add polli harness with DeepSeek Harness profile
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `polli harness dsh on|off|status`; `polli harness --help` discovers adapters.
- Configures DeepSeek Harness as a native Pollinations provider with live tool-capable models.
- Logs in when needed, mints a dedicated `polli-harness-dsh` child key, and stores it in owner-only DSH files.
- Keeps the shared command layer thin so future adapters can own direct-provider or plugin-based setup.
- Persists snapshots before configuration, fails loudly on damaged backups, rolls back partial failures, and restores or surgically strips changes on `off`.
- Adds Scalar, CLI, and contributor documentation.

Tests: `npm test` (24 passed), `npm run build`, Biome, command help smoke checks, and packed-install `on → status → key reuse → off → invalid model` end-to-end flow.

gist.headline: Polli harnesses DeepSeek
gist.blurb: The CLI grew a harness for DeepSeek Harness, so Pollinations models can move into a tool-capable coding setup without manual key wrangling. Polli packs a dedicated key, saves a snapshot, and knows how to put the shed back the way she found it.
gist.summary: Added `polli harness dsh on|off|status`, which configures DeepSeek Harness as a native Pollinations provider with live tool-capable models, a dedicated `polli-harness-dsh` child key, snapshots, rollback, and clean removal.
gist.impact: Developers can connect DeepSeek Harness to Pollinations through one CLI command, reuse its dedicated key safely, inspect its status, and restore or surgically remove the configuration with `off`.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful stable hand fitting a small harness onto the eager CRT Monitor Robot, representing DeepSeek Harness gaining a native Pollinations connection. A cozy terminal shows `polli harness dsh on`, while a tiny labeled key, backup snapshot jar, and flowering code-plants communicate secure setup, rollback, and future adapter growth.
